query:
SELECT
                     id                     as "id!: i64",
                     media_kind,
                     media_id               as "media_id!: i64",
                     audio_track            as "audio_track!: i64",
                     language,
                     model,
                     vtt_path,
                     json_path,
                     created_at             as "created_at!: i64",
                     duration_processed_sec as "duration_processed_sec?: f64"
                   FROM transcripts
                   WHERE content_key = ? AND audio_track = ?
                   ORDER BY created_at DESC
                   LIMIT 1
